name: Point CounterPoint Youth Sessions
description_short: A chamber music camp on Lake Dunmore in Vermont, running since 1963. It offers five youth sessions from June to August, each with its own age range and music director, built around daily coachings, lessons, rehearsals and concerts.
activities: Canoeing on Lake Dunmore (Fourth of July)
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on the shore of Lake Dunmore. On the Fourth of July, campers go out on the lake in canoes to watch fireworks. The page says nothing about swimming or waterfront supervision.
